title: The Pile at the Edge
hook: Somebody left a ridge of gravel along the shoulder.
scene: A windrow runs the right edge for the next half mile — loose gravel piled where the grader pushed it and never came back. It looks like shoulder. It is a rope laid along the road.

source.psdp_skill: Skill twelve: driving on rural roads
source.teaching_target: PSDP twelve — gravel windrow / pile at the edge. PSDP-only (n/a DOL).

image_brief.subject: REAL GRAVEL WINDROW: a continuous low ridge of loose piled gravel along the RIGHT road edge for the next half mile — grader-pushed windrow / rope of stones on the shoulder, NOT a cut slope / road cut / embankment / ditch bank / hillside; travel track clear LEFT of the windrow; through FULL-GRID mesh. INSIDE-cabin locked carrier on passenger floor ONLY (never on hood, never outside windshield, never beyond the mesh on exterior body): hard-sided; wire grille door facing inboard; Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille; belt routed through the handle
image_brief.foreground: worn black wheel; faded pink dash DARK/UNLIT — no lit green turn arrows; READABLE analog gauges with needles + face markings (NOT blank black gauge circles); odo/trip OK; ABSOLUTE BAN on digital 112 / 112.0 / speedlike LCD; FULL-GRID welded steel mesh over the entire windshield (VI-009 cage canon) — not a low dash-level band; missing windshield cage is a hard FAIL; carrier HARD LOCK: hard-sided pet carrier sits INSIDE the cabin on the passenger-side floor / footwell, THIS SIDE of the windshield mesh — NEVER on the hood, NEVER outside the glass, NEVER resting on exterior pink body ahead of the cage; wire grille door facing inboard; Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille; belt routed through the handle
image_brief.midground: REAL windrow = continuous ridge of LOOSE piled gravel / crushed rock along the right shoulder like a rope the grader left — six-inch-deep pile you could drive into; travel lane / graded track clear to the LEFT of that ridge; fir crowding the ditch beyond the pile. HARD FAIL if the right edge is only a cut slope, excavated bank, grassy embankment, ditch wall, or natural hillside with no piled gravel ridge
image_brief.background: Cascades-west PNW wet backcountry — restricted sightlines, second-growth fir crowding the shoulder, blackberry and alder in the ditch, vegetation close to the road, wet gray asphalt; NOT sage, dry grass, bare hills, or long open highway; soft wet dirt beyond the windrow; no other cars
image_brief.read: loose gravel is piled in a long windrow along the right edge; carrier locked INSIDE cabin; readable gauges; dark dash; no 112
extra_negatives: no second person in the car
no cat loose on the seat
no "ginger tabby" wording — use orange tabby markings behind the grille
no carrier door facing outboard toward camera
no empty carrier with no cat visible behind grille
no belt not routed through handle
no carrier beyond the mesh on exterior bodywork
no carrier sitting on exterior pink paint ahead of the cage
no pet carrier resting on the hood visible through the grid
no cut slope instead of windrow
no road cut / excavated bank as the right-edge subject
no grassy embankment or ditch wall standing in for a gravel windrow
no natural hillside with no piled gravel ridge
no empty gauge circles without needles or numerals
no low dash-level mesh band only
no brightly lit dash by default
no speedlike 112 LCD readout (odo/trip numerals OK if not live speed)
no digital 112.0 in any gauge window
no desert GPS / arid nav HUD
Ali alone — only VI-013 has a second person

variation.forced: Act VI wave-1 remainder REGEN VI-003: Cascades-west PNW; full-grid cage; carrier SPEC verbatim INSIDE cabin (not hood); real gravel windrow not cut slope; readable gauges not blank; dark dash; no 112.0; no seed

decision: The windrow is on your right. Where do you put the tires?

options.text: Left of it, in the graded track, and give it room
options.result: You stay in the part somebody meant you to drive on. The pile sits out there being a pile.

options.text: Straddle it so you are using the full width
options.result: One wheel in loose and one in packed, and the car starts arguing with itself about which way is straight.

options.text: Ride the far right so oncoming traffic has all the room it wants
options.result: You put the right side into the windrow to be generous. It takes the wheel out of your hands and points you at the ditch.
It is gravel that is six inches deep in a line. That is not the same gravel you are already on.

debrief: Watch for windrows — piled gravel at the road edge grabs a wheel.
